title: Michael's medical exam and injection (sodium pentothal)
place_text: Ellsworth AFB medical facility, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I just remember I just remember they shot some some in me uh something in my vein and stuff and uh

plain: Michael Johnson, a former US Air Force guard at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, says that after a strange encounter at a missile site around November 1977, he was given a medical exam at the base. On the podcast of host Jesse Michels, he says they injected something into his vein, which in the story is said to be sodium pentothal, a drug sometimes called truth serum. If true, it would mean the Air Force questioned or sedated him about what he saw.
